runoff_source: USGS SIR 2014-5162 figure 7, directly connected impervious-area surface runoff, inches over the onshore Miami-Dade study area
note: Rainfall is the NOAA annual total at Miami International Airport. Runoff is predicted from rainfall using a line fit to USGS Miami-Dade surface-runoff estimates for 1996-2010. The 95% ranges are prediction intervals for a new year, not confidence intervals for the mean trend.
